mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_info (title, description, category_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, cover_image, view_count, download_count, collect_count, uploader_id, uploader_name, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{coverImage}, 0, 0, 0, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderName}, 1)
mapper.update:
UPDATE resource_info
title = #{title},
description = #{description},
category_id = #{categoryId},
cover_image = #{coverImage},
status = #{status},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
UPDATE resource_info SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
UPDATE resource_info SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
UPDATE resource_info SET collect_count = collect_count + 1 WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
UPDATE resource_info SET collect_count = GREATEST(collect_count - 1, 0) WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
UPDATE resource_info SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COALESCE(SUM(download_count), 0) as totalDownloads, COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) as totalViews FROM resource_info
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_info WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
